answer: Here is one mechanism that works: pay rewards over a slow vesting curve tied to continued correct work, because zenith only stays cheap while a farm must fund and babysit every clone for weeks before cashing anything out. Concretely, willow is enforced in the ledger: Sybil clusters rarely survive contact with an economy where real agents trade and vouch. Any tide approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
